records.title: LUT input significance
records.claim: For LUT4, address = I0 + 2*I1 + 4*I2 + 8*I3; INIT[address] is the combinational result. INIT is a logical vector indexed from zero, not a host-endian integer layout.
records.rationale: Explicit Foundation acceptance boundary; reviewed against architecture, early-baseline contract and pinned FABulous source where applicable.
independent_expected_examples: I3..I0=0001 selects INIT[1]; 1000 selects INIT[8].
INIT with only bits 1, 4 and 11 set returns 1 at addresses 1, 4, 11 and 0 otherwise.

records.title: Mux ordering and legal values
